title: Ottoman–Safavid War (1616–1618)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Ottoman–Safavid War (1616–1618)", at revision 1380713678, opens: "The Ottoman–Safavid War of 1616–1618 was a brief war between the Ottoman Empire and Safavid Iran." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q12846172, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "last phase of the Ottoman–Safavid War (1603–1618)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
